paragraphs:
The XE D200 is powered by the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. It was fitted to the X760-generation XE from approximately 2015 until diesel was phased out of the UK and North American ranges around 2020, as Jaguar moved the XE to a predominantly petrol-only lineup in some markets. The D200 sits in the mid-to-upper tier of the XE diesel range, offering more output than the D150 and D165, but sharing the same Ingenium AJ200D engine architecture across the family.

The XE D200 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every XE D200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the XE D200 from 2015 to approximately 2020 (X760 generation). Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — we inspect and replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
